paragraphs: R' Yitzchak ben Parnakh — [Kallah Rabbati, beginning of chapter 3](https://www.sefaria.org/Tractate_Kallah_Rabbati.3.1).[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: Hyman’s supplied locator reads כג.., 23a. The corresponding passage at 63a names Chizkiyah son of Rabbi Parnakh speaking in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1221&lang=en) cites 63a for that report.
The first patronymic includes Rabbi before Parnakh. The second gives simply ben Parnakh.
Kallah Rabbati names Rabbi Yitzchak bar Parnakh at the beginning of chapter 3. These two references do not establish that the patronymics refer to the same father.
